_comment: agents-on-modal model catalog. Each entry is parsed into agents_on_modal.models.Model and fully describes one persistent Modal deployment (app aom-<name>, weights volume aom-<name>-weights). 'reasoning.efforts' maps the normalized effort scale (none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) onto an engine value: a string is sent as reasoning_effort=<value> with thinking on; true = thinking on with no effort parameter; false = thinking off. 'reasoning.kwarg' is the chat-template thinking switch. Parsers, GPU sizing and image notes are hard-won; see git history of the old catalog.json and docs/DESIGN.md.

qwen3.8-27b.description: Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (dense hybrid, ~29 GiB) on 1x H100. Agentic-coding default for tests: evaluated with coding harnesses, reliable qwen3_coder tool calls. reasoning_effort must be low/medium/xhigh ONLY (the chat template raises on high/max/minimal), so the effort map never emits those.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.description: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (MoE, 3B active, ~35 GiB) on 1x H100. Cheapest/fastest capable option; no reasoning-effort knob in the template (thinking just on/off). preserve_thinking true for agent tool loops.

gpt-oss-120b.description: openai/gpt-oss-120b (MXFP4, 5.1B active, ~61 GiB) on 1x H200. Different model family for cross-checks; harmony always reasons; effort low/medium/high only (none errors).

deepseek-v4-flash-0731.description: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (304B MoE, ~156 GiB) via SGLang on H200:2. Thinking is OFF unless an effort is sent; the official profile honors low/high/max. marlin MoE runner + swa ratio are the proven Hopper recipe.

glm-5.3-flash-uncensored.description: orcarouter/GLM-5.3-Flash-Uncensored-FP8 (320B/18B MoE, block-FP8, ~306 GiB) via SGLang on B300:2. glm47 tool parser + glm45 reasoning are mandatory (auto picks wrong). Template always opens <think>; effort low/high/max, anything else becomes max, so always send an explicit level. mem-fraction-static 0.78 is required at tp2 (0.92 OOMs cuda-graph capture).

deepseek-v4-flash-abliterated.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 abliterated (uncensored) via SGLang on H200:2; self-contained (downloads its own ~156 GiB weights to its own Volume -- no base-volume reuse, which previously depended on a stale v1 cm-codex volume requested as v2 and failed at deploy).

glm-5.3-abliterated-nvfp4.description: GLM-5.3 abliterated, NVFP4 (ModelOpt experts-only W4A4, ~433 GiB) via SGLang on B300:2. NVFP4 needs Blackwell; B300 (288 GiB/GPU) is the cheapest fit since TP must be a power of 2 and B200 (180 GiB) would need 4. No transformers pin: the v0.5.19 image ships 5.12.1, which already has glm_moe_dsa - forcing 5.16.0 makes SGLang's qwen3_asr config registration collide with the now-native one and the server exits 1 before the health check.

glm-5.3-uncensored-nvfp4.description: GLM-5.3 uncensored (dealignai), NVFP4 (ModelOpt experts-only W4A4, ~433 GiB) via SGLang on B300:2. NVFP4 needs Blackwell; B300 (288 GiB/GPU) is the cheapest fit since TP must be a power of 2 and B200 (180 GiB) would need 4. No transformers pin: the v0.5.19 image ships 5.12.1, which already has glm_moe_dsa - forcing 5.16.0 makes SGLang's qwen3_asr config registration collide with the now-native one and the server exits 1 before the health check.

deepseek-v4-flash-vision-uncensored.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Uncensored (orcarouter) - the multimodal (image+text) sibling of the deepseek-v4-flash-abliterated entry - via SGLang on H200:2. REQUIRES the preview image lmsysorg/sglang:dev-dsv4-flash-vision (SGLang PR #37253): this adds the ViT + aligner (deepseek_v4_vit.py) and the mm image processor, and has NOT shipped in a stock release. The v0.5.19-cu130 image the non-vision entry uses CANNOT load this checkpoint - its text-only DeepseekV4ForCausalLM class dies with KeyError 'aligner.gate_up_proj.weight' in load_weights (then SIGKILL -9), because the HF architecture string is still DeepseekV4ForCausalLM yet the weights include the vision aligner/tower. config.json: model_type deepseek_v4, block-FP8 e4m3 weight_block_size [128,128] with ue8m0 scales (the card's prose claiming 'FP4 experts' is wrong; quant_method is plain fp8, no expert_dtype). ~156.3 GiB across 48 shards, so H200:2 (282 GiB) holds it with ~126 GiB spare - the OOM-shaped -9 in logs was the aligner KeyError killing the TP group, NOT a memory shortfall, so mem-fraction-static 0.85 is fine. The model is hybrid-SWA (sliding_window 128) with a DSA indexer, so the KV pool is small. Keeps the proven Hopper recipe otherwise (marlin MoE runner, swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1, deepseek-v4/deepseekv4 parser pair, trust-remote-code). Each image uses at most 1024 tokens after auto-resize. DSpark speculative decoding is available (--speculative-algorithm DSPARK) but left off for a known-good bring-up. GATED repo (base DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp); HF_TOKEN must have access - verified it does. No base_volume reuse: all 156 GiB download fresh. Do NOT carry marlin to a Blackwell GPU - SGLang's B200/B300 cells for this checkpoint use flashinfer_mxfp4 instead.

deepseek-v4.1-flash-uncensored-fp8.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UNCENSORED-FP8 (dealignai, 763B total/multimodal) via SGLang on B300:4. REQUIRES the preview image lmsysorg/sglang:dev-dsv41: config.json is DeepseekV41ForCausalLM / model_type deepseek_v41, a NEW architecture that has not shipped in any stock SGLang release (support lives only on the dsv4.1 branch / this dev image), so the v0.5.19-cu130 image the other entries use cannot load it. Quant is DeepSeek-native FP8 e4m3 with ue8m0 block scales at [32,32] PLUS expert_dtype fp4 (not ModelOpt NVFP4). SIZING - the key lesson: at ~475.3 GiB the weights alone are too big for 4xH200. On H200:4 tp4 that is ~118.8 GiB/GPU = 85% of the 139 GiB usable, and SGLang hard-fails at boot with 'Loaded weights leave no GPU memory for the KV cache under --mem-fraction-static=0.8 ... minimum viable 0.870'; pushing mem-fraction above 0.87 then starves the ~10% non-static pool and cuda-graph capture OOMs (exit -9), the same failure the GLM NVFP4 entry hit at 0.92. The model card's 0.80/4xH200 recipe was for a smaller base artifact, not this 475 GiB uncensored build. B300:2 tp2 is worse (~237.6 GiB/GPU = 89%). B300:4 tp4 is the right fit: ~118.8 GiB/GPU of B300's ~267.7 GiB usable = 44%, so at mem-fraction-static 0.85 the KV pool is ~100+ GiB/GPU with ~40 GiB/GPU left for cuda-graph capture - comfortable, and it keeps the card-verified tp4 parallelism while running the FP4 experts on Blackwell natively. Parsers are --reasoning-parser auto / --tool-call-parser auto per SGLang's V4.1 cookbook (the dev image resolves deepseek-v41 from the model config). ep-size 4 matches tp. Backends (attention/moe-runner/fp8-gemm) are deliberately NOT pinned - the cookbook warns manual overrides fall back to slow Triton; confirm the resolved backends in the startup log. Context capped at 262144 (the checkpoint supports 1M via yarn factor 16 from 65536, but every catalog entry caps at 256k). DSpark speculative decoding (--speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5) is available but left OFF for a known-good bring-up; add it only with a re-verified run.

deepseek-v4.1-flash-abliterated-gguf.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-abliterated (orcarouter), GGUF quant served by llama.cpp on H200:2 - the catalog's first non-SGLang runtime (runtime: llamacpp). GGUF is a llama.cpp container, not safetensors, so SGLang cannot load it; the llamacpp runtime builds llama-server from source instead of pulling an SGLang image. These GGUFs further require an UNMERGED build - llama.cpp PR #30817 at commit b72050d03 (pinned in codex_modal/runtimes.py) - because DeepSeek-V4.1's architecture is in no tagged release; stock llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio refuse to load them. serving_image is omitted so the runtime uses its CUDA devel base (nvidia/cuda:12.8.0-devel) and compiles with CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES derived from the GPU (90 for H200/Hopper). download_subdir=Mix-256G fetches only the production quant (235.8 GiB in-memory, 346 GiB download, 3.36 bpw, ~93.7% token-agreement with the original) - not the testing-only Mix-128G or the imatrix. Sized to H200:2 per the model card's '2 GPUs with ~250GB total VRAM' (282 GiB total holds the 235.8 GiB weights with headroom); the runtime globs the first shard (â€¦-00001-of-â€¦) and llama.cpp auto-loads the rest with -ngl 99 splitting layers across both GPUs. server_args mirror the card's known-good command (-np 1 --no-reasoning-preserve); the runtime ALWAYS adds --jinja (required for llama-server tool calling: without it DeepSeek-V4.1's DSML tool-call tokens leak out as plain assistant text and the agent harness stalls -- fixed in llamacpp.py). context_window raised to 131072 (from 32768): DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses MLA (tiny compressed KV), so the server KV holds it easily on H200:2, and the larger window stops Claude Code's big system prompt from forcing premature auto-compaction (which derailed the model into a meta-summary mid-task). harness window == server -c, so auto-compaction never overflows the real KV. NOTE: this GGUF ships no mmproj projector, so it is TEXT-ONLY here (llama.cpp vision needs a separate mmproj) - unlike the safetensors V4.1 entry, which is multimodal. target_inputs=1 matches --parallel 1; raise both together for concurrency once KV headroom is confirmed.

glm-5.3-uncensored-fp8.description: GLM-5.3 uncensored (dealignai), block-FP8 e4m3 -- the FULL 753B glm_moe_dsa model (NOT the 320B Flash), ~703.7 GiB across 282 shards -- via SGLang on B300:4. Same arch and parsers as the glm-5.3-*-nvfp4 entries: glm45 reasoning + glm47 tool-call are mandatory (auto picks wrong), the template always opens <think>, and reasoning_effort honors low/high only (anything else becomes max), so always send an explicit level. Image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.19-cu130 is the proven glm_moe_dsa image (its transformers 5.12.1 already registers glm_moe_dsa; do NOT force 5.16.0 -- it collides with SGLang's qwen3_asr config registration and the server exits 1 before the health check). This is FP8 BLOCK quant, so unlike the NVFP4 entries there is NO --quantization flag: SGLang auto-detects block-FP8 from config.json. SIZING: at 703.7 GiB the weights need 4 GPUs. B300:4 tp4 = ~176 GiB/GPU = ~66% of B300's ~267.7 GiB usable -- comfortable: mem-fraction-static 0.85 leaves ~51 GiB/GPU static + ~40 GiB/GPU non-static for cuda-graph capture. B300:2 (~352 GiB/GPU) does not fit; H200:4 (~176/139 = 127%) does not fit. The card's 8xH200 TP8 vLLM recipe (max-model-len 131072, gpu-mem-util 0.90, enforce-eager) is the Hopper fallback; B300:4 is a cheaper power-of-2 TP that runs FP8 natively on Blackwell. CONTEXT: full 262144 fits because glm_moe_dsa uses DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) -- the KV pool is small (the NVFP4 full-GLM entries already serve 256k on B300:2 with far less KV headroom), so NO fp8 kv-cache is needed (and DSA + fp8-kv is unproven). --chunked-prefill-size=8192 (proven on the NVFP4 GLM entries) keeps long-context prefill throughput up; --ep-size=4 matches tp. MoE/gemm backends are NOT pinned -- SGLang auto-resolves deep_gemm/cutlass on Blackwell; confirm the resolved backends in the startup log. Text-only (no vision). If 256k KV ever refuses to fit at boot, drop context to 131072 (the card's H200 ceiling) rather than pushing mem-fraction past 0.85 (that starves capture -> exit -9).

deepseek-v4.1-flash-huihui-gguf.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 abliterated by huihui-ai, GGUF (Unsloth Dynamic UD-IQ1_M, ~233.2 GiB across 5 shards) served by llama.cpp on H200:2. Same deepseek41 architecture as the orcarouter deepseek-v4.1-flash-abliterated-gguf entry, so the same UNMERGED llama.cpp PR #30817 (commit b72050d03, pinned in agents_on_modal/models/engines/llamacpp.py) loads it; stock llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio refuse it. engine=llamacpp (GGUF is a llama.cpp container, not safetensors, so SGLang cannot load it); the runtime compiles llama-server from that PR on a CUDA-devel base (CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=90 for Hopper). download_subdir=UD-IQ1_M fetches only the higher of huihui's two 1-bit dynamic quants (UD-IQ1_M 233.2 GiB vs UD-IQ1_S 217.0 GiB; the unsloth/Maya/Strata folders are small patch GGUFs, NOT full weights). CAVEAT -- these are 1-bit (IQ1) dynamic quants, far more aggressive than orcarouter's 3.36 bpw Mix-256G (~93.7% token agreement), so expect noticeably lower fidelity: this entry exists to cover the huihui-ai abliteration, not for best quality. ~233 GiB fits H200:2 (282 GiB total) with headroom, matching how Mix-256G (235.8 GiB) was sized; the runtime globs the first shard (...-UD-IQ1_M-00001-of-00005.gguf, a 10 MB index shard) and -ngl 99 splits all layers across both GPUs (shard 5 alone is 103 GiB, but llama.cpp distributes by layer, not by shard). server args mirror the known-good orcarouter command (-np 1 --no-reasoning-preserve); the runtime ALWAYS adds --jinja (required for llama-server tool calling: without it DeepSeek-V4.1's DSML tool-call tokens leak out as plain assistant text and an agent harness stalls on turn 1 -- fixed in llamacpp.py). context_window is 131072: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses MLA (a tiny compressed KV, ~9 GiB at 131072 vs H200:2's ~46 GiB headroom), so the server KV holds far more than 32k, and the bigger window keeps Claude Code's large system prompt + tool defs from triggering premature auto-compaction (which derailed this 1-bit quant into emitting a meta-summary). harness window == server -c, so auto-compaction never overflows the real KV. CAVEAT: even served correctly, this UD-IQ1_M 1-bit quant is too degraded for reliable multi-step agent loops (it narrates steps without calling tools, or repetition-collapses) -- fine for smoke/generation, not for agentic work. TEXT-ONLY: this GGUF ships no mmproj projector (llama.cpp vision needs a separate mmproj). target_concurrency=1 matches --parallel 1; raise both together once KV headroom is confirmed.
